features.actual: Real PlayStream returned a valid handle and logged StopStream at simulation 2.01667s. WASAPI capture matched the 733Hz code (best correlation 0.795; gain 0.096), then tone amplitude was zero from about capture 9.5s through the 12s capture end. Runtime continued until it exited 0 at 11:13:00Z, after the capture ended at 11:12:37Z. This confirms loopback output followed by stopped-stream silence while the process was still alive; no millisecond stop latency claimed and no subjective listening claim.
features.expected: Start a looping PCM stream, observe the unique coded signal at the render endpoint, call StopStream, then observe silence before the same Runtime process exits; do not claim exact Stop latency without capture and call clocks aligned.
